message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "fallback_to_report_for_morphological_details", "description": "When a structured classifier returns empty findings for a suspected structural anomaly, invoke the report generator to extract descriptive morphological details for differential diagnosis.", "applicable_conditions": "Applicable when interpreting medical imaging where a primary classification tool yields negative or empty results for a specific finding despite clinical suspicion or ambiguous visual evidence, requiring detailed textual description for further analysis.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "medium", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns empty `strong_findings` for a suspected structural anomaly (e.g., mediastinal widening, mass effect): (1) Do not conclude absence of pathology based solely on the classifier output; (2) Invoke `chest_xray_report_generator` to obtain a free-text radiological report; (3) Extract morphological descriptors (e.g., contour shape, calcification, border definition) from the generated text; (4) Base the subsequent differential diagnosis on these textual descriptions rather than the negative classifier output."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
